models_evaluated: four general-purpose ML algorithms (unnamed in abstract)

links.outcome: ML model performance (false positive/negative rates) for asymptomatic BV diagnosis across ethnic groups
links.effect: Performance varied by ethnicity; models performed least effectively for Hispanic and Asian women on false positive/negative rates, highest for white women and lowest for Asian women. No numeric values in abstract.
links.quote: Models generally have the highest performance for white women and the lowest for Asian women.

screen.reason: Evaluates fairness and algorithmic bias across ethnic groups for machine learning models diagnosing bacterial vaginosis using 16S rRNA sequencing data.
